depends_on.description: Resolved dependency relation between two releases.

registry_reports_signing_key.description: An ecosystem registry's metadata associates this artifact with this signing key. This is an OBSERVATION of what the registry claims; NO cryptographic verification of the signature against the artifact bytes has been performed. Policies requiring strong evidence must require `cryptographically_verified_signature_by` (Phase-2 predicate, not yet emitted).

published_by.description: Identity recorded by the registry as publisher of a release.

published_at.description: Release timestamp as recorded by the registry.

affected_by.description: Artifact is affected by a vulnerability advisory.

attests_to.description: Attestation envelope refers to a subject.

revises.description: Supersession edge: this assertion replaces another. Meta-predicate.
